title: Best App to Save Recipes From Anywhere
description: A criteria-based guide to recipe apps for people who save recipes from TikTok, Instagram, Pinterest, and food blogs and want one searchable collection.
claims: TasteBuddy imports recipes from websites and social media into one searchable collection.

hero: If your recipes are spread across tabs, screenshots, and social saves, the right recipe app should do more than store links.
decision_criteria: Can it import from websites and social media without manual cleanup?
Can it turn saved recipes into a weekly plan and shopping list?
Can it keep your collection searchable across devices?
